_comment: Connections beyond the edge of the taxi map. 'taxiways' continue from where 'from' leaves the map and end at 'runway'. 'runwayLinks' say that a taxiway reaches a runway beyond the map edge (where it leaves the map). Neither is drawn; both connect at the map edge. A runway link with 'connect' also lets routes along that taxiway reach the runway there (hold short at the map edge).
